topic: the ideation record for a proof-carrying point-to-point latent map: design variations considered for mapping unlabeled corpora onto sphere geometry as a deployable browser/Worker tool, and the finalist design decisions

subtopics.scope: How the 7 design variations were generated (forced lenses: inversion, constraint removal, audience shift, combination, simplification) and scored on the P/S/D/T matrix with threshold 8.
seed_queries: ideation method scoring ideas criteria painkiller defensibility testability matrix
design space exploration forced lenses inversion constraint removal ideation techniques

subtopics.scope: The proof-carrying constraint: Lean-checked identities (atom delta nonnegativity, composition, stationary law) may be enforced as runtime assertions but never recast as measurement claims.
seed_queries: proof-carrying code runtime verification certificates Necula
Lean theorem proving verified software runtime assertions deployment

subtopics.scope: Why point-to-point identity needs a separate layer: measurement classes collide (2286 items to 176 classes, slugs collide), only the row ordinal is injective.
seed_queries: entity resolution identity layer separate from measurement data
hash collision resistant identifiers deduplication record identity

subtopics.scope: The admitted binary state {0,1}^{N x d}, the per-axis median binarization rule as part of the map key, and the fixed-margin curveball null versus column-permutation nulls.
seed_queries: binarize embedding vectors median threshold Hamming space
curveball permutation null fixed margin swap test statistics

subtopics.scope: Placement geometry choices compared: S2 stereographic lift with spherical harmonics, continuous slerp on the unit sphere with vMF concentration, and Hamming-native Krawtchouk shells.
seed_queries: spherical harmonics embedding visualization dimensionality reduction sphere
slerp geodesic interpolation unit sphere von Mises-Fisher concentration

subtopics.scope: The three edge types (atom moves, null trades, slerp bridges), each emitting a certificate that names the theorem it shadows, split into identity checks versus honest-fail measurement checks.
seed_queries: Sigstore Rekor transparency log attestation evidence
verifiable computation certificate runtime proof checking

subtopics.scope: The deployable shape: one dependency-free TypeScript module running client-side in the browser first, then mounted behind /api/map on a Cloudflare Worker with D1 persistence, with the static single-file sphere as the MVP cut.
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers D1 single dependency-free TypeScript module architecture
browser-only static single file visualization tool no backend

subtopics.scope: Testability discipline: pre-registered degeneracy check on the curveball null (SD0 threshold), the admission null gating the v2 continuous channel, and the WebGPU reverse-diffusion bet left at G5.
seed_queries: preregistration statistical test null distribution degenerate variance
Monte Carlo permutation test null distribution power sample size
